capability.heading: From mechanical design to field support

su-banyosu.name: SB-9K tissue flotation bath
su-banyosu.tagline: Stretches paraffin sections from the microtome on a water surface held at a constant temperature, ready to be picked up on a slide.
su-banyosu.description: A tissue flotation water bath for histopathology labs. The matte black PTFE-coated aluminium reservoir makes translucent sections only a few microns thick stand out against a dark background, and LED illumination makes wrinkles easy to follow. A PID controller drives the silicone heater bonded to the reservoir floor. In the simulation you can change the setpoint, watch the section flatten and pick it up on a slide.
features: PID temperature control with a digital LED display
Silicone heater bonded to the reservoir floor
Secondary safety thermostat protecting the heater

dijital-patoloji.name: AhtaPatolog
dijital-patoloji.tagline: Viewing, annotation and case management for the pathologist's review.
dijital-patoloji.description: Opens whole-slide images in the browser so the pathologist can examine tissue at high magnification, annotate it and keep cases organised. Diagnostic decisions remain with the pathologist; the software supports the review.
features: Synchronised side-by-side comparison of two slides
screens: Gallery: uploaded slides and their annotation counts
Compare: two slides side by side with synchronised navigation

about.heading: About
about.lead: Ahtapot Medical Technologies is a medical device company founded by a physician. Our aim is to design and build in Türkiye the medical devices that are sourced from abroad today.
about.body: We develop the mechanics, electronics and software of each device ourselves. Because the design knowledge stays with us, we never wait on anyone to change a part, add a feature or ship an update.

pillars.title: Designed and built locally
pillars.text: Every layer of the device is designed and prepared for production in Türkiye, reducing dependence on imports for spare parts, maintenance and updates.

pillars.title: A physician's perspective
pillars.text: Requirements are defined by a physician who knows the clinic from the inside. Each device is designed around where it will be used and who will use it.

pillars.title: End-to-end responsibility
pillars.text: From the first drawing to maintenance in the field, we run every stage ourselves, so every matter has a single point of contact.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Dr. Mustafa Can Yılmaz
founder.bio: Alongside medicine, works in software, electronics and mechanical design: defines the clinical requirements of each device and takes a hands-on part in its circuit, code and enclosure design.

kvkk.title: Privacy notice (KVKK)
kvkk.legalReviewNote: This is a draft and must be reviewed by legal counsel before publication.
body: This notice is issued by Ahtapot Tıbbi Teknolojiler A.Ş. ("the Company") as data controller under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").
The name, email address, organisation and message you share through the contact form are processed to assess your request and get back to you.
Your data is not stored in a database. The form is delivered directly as an email and used only to answer your request.
Under Article 11 of KVKK you have the right to learn whether your data is processed and for what purpose, and to request its correction or deletion.
You can send these requests in writing to the address in the contact section.
